quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 Bitcoin production and mining update (unaudited): Canaan mined 44 BTC and held 1,875 BTC on its balance sheet at month-end. Non-JV installed and operating hashrate 10.00 EH/s; JV (its 49% stake in the Alborz, Bear and Chief Mountain facilities in West Texas) installed hashrate 4.87 EH/s and operating hashrate 4.18 EH/s; month-end average revenue split 60.5% (excluding JV ownership); average all-in power cost US$0.043/kWh; global miner efficiency non-JV 23.7 J/TH and JV 24.6 J/TH; installed power capacity non-JV 244.9 MW and JV 120 MW; 12 active mining projects with 15.14 EH/s estimated total computing power (Canada 0.27 EH/s expected but not yet installed); mining operations in Ethiopia are paused, with that hashrate still counted as installed. CEO Nangeng Zhang: hashprice extended its recovery from August, 'pointing to improving mining economics'; the 8 MW Nordic district heating project is now fully operational, delivering recovered computing heat to approximately 2,800 homes, and the Canadian greenhouse heat recovery project is moving toward planned deployment, pending the completion of site inspections.
quarterly_data.figure: September 2026: 44 BTC mined; 1,875 BTC held; 10.00 EH/s non-JV; JV 4.87 EH/s installed; 8 MW Nordic district heating project operational
